body: The new integration tests only assert the *absence* of bare `col-span-2/3` classes. As written, they would still pass if `getResponsiveSpanClass()` regressed to always returning an empty string (because the `querySelectorAll('[class*="col-span"]')` result could be empty and the `forEach` would no-op). Add at least one positive assertion that the wide field element actually contains the expected responsive class (e.g., `md:col-span-2` / `lg:col-span-3`) so the tests detect missing spans as well.
